primary_business_goal: Convert visitors to signup or trial
copy_summary: Headline 'Design, prototype, develop. All in Figma.' with animated product showcase. Emphasis on collaboration and all-in-one platform.
notes: The animated product demo shows real collaboration happening. 'Free' prominently featured reduces barrier. Company logos provide social proof. Clean, professional design matches product quality.

primary_user_goal: Understand key features and how Figma works
primary_business_goal: Build desire and differentiate from competitors
copy_summary: Feature sections: Real-time collaboration, Components and variants, Prototyping, Developer handoff. Each with video/animation demo.
notes: Video demos show features in action rather than just describing them. Alternating layout keeps scrolling interesting. Real-time collaboration is the key differentiator and shown prominently.

copy_summary: Simple signup form: Email, password. Social login options. Link to sign in for existing users.
notes: Minimal signup form - email and password only. Google SSO reduces friction significantly. No unnecessary fields or questions. Clean design matches product aesthetic.

primary_user_goal: Indicate role and use case for personalized experience
primary_business_goal: Segment users for onboarding path and marketing
copy_summary: Question 'What do you want to do in Figma?' with options: Design, Prototype, Handoff to developers, Brainstorm, etc.
notes: Role selection enables personalized onboarding. Options cover full spectrum from designers to developers. Skip option available for users who want to explore freely.

primary_business_goal: Enable productive design work that creates switching costs
copy_summary: Infinite canvas with toolbar at top, layers panel on left, properties panel on right. Frame shows design in progress.
notes: The canvas is the core of Figma. Infinite zoom and pan. Panels can be hidden for more canvas space. Tool discovery through toolbar and right-click menus. Quick actions with keyboard shortcuts.

primary_user_goal: Collaborate with team members in real-time
primary_business_goal: Demonstrate collaboration value and increase team adoption
copy_summary: Canvas showing multiple cursors with collaborator names. Real-time updates as others edit. Avatar stack in top right showing who's viewing.
notes: Multiplayer cursors are Figma's signature feature. Each collaborator has colored cursor with name. Changes appear instantly. This is the killer feature that drives team adoption.

primary_user_goal: Create and manage reusable design components
primary_business_goal: Enable design systems that increase platform value
copy_summary: Assets panel showing component library. Organized by file/team. Search to find components. Drag to canvas to use.
notes: Components panel enables design systems. Search is crucial for large libraries. Team libraries shared across files. Variants visible within component cards.

primary_business_goal: Enable end-to-end design workflow in Figma
copy_summary: Prototype mode showing blue connection lines between frames. Interaction details panel on right. Triggers and animations configurable.
notes: Visual wire-framing of interactions. Blue lines show prototype flow at a glance. Interaction triggers are comprehensive. Smart animate creates smooth transitions automatically.

primary_user_goal: Share design with team members or stakeholders
primary_business_goal: Drive collaboration and increase team size
copy_summary: Share modal with: Invite by email, Copy link, Permission settings (view, edit, comment). Team/organization sharing options.
notes: Sharing is viral growth engine. Link sharing is one-click. Permission levels clear. Can share with people outside organization. Embed option for documentation.

copy_summary: Community hub showing design files, plugins, widgets. Categories: UI Kits, Icons, Wireframes, etc. Search and filter options.
notes: Community is a massive value-add. Free resources for designers. Plugins extend functionality. This ecosystem creates platform lock-in and increases value for all users.
